scripts.dev: wait-on tcp:8788 && wait-on tcp:8789 && bun scripts/dev.mjs
scripts.deploy: wrangler deploy --minify --outdir dist --upload-source-maps --var SENTRY_RELEASE:$(sentry-cli releases propose-version)
scripts.deploy:prod: wrangler deploy --env production --minify --outdir dist --upload-source-maps --var SENTRY_RELEASE:$(sentry-cli releases propose-version)
scripts.sentry:sourcemaps: _SENTRY_RELEASE=$(sentry-cli releases propose-version) && sentry-cli releases new $_SENTRY_RELEASE --org=shaky-hand --project=cook-club-api && sentry-cli sourcemaps upload --org=shaky-hand --project=cook-club-api --release=$_SENTRY_RELEASE --strip-prefix 'dist/..' dist
